label: Cause of being causes every perfection, from universal and nonuniversal transfer
description: Suppose c causes x's esse and x is in act in r. x is not c, since nothing causes its own esse (CausesIn x x esse never holds). By excluded middle c either causes the esse of every other actual being or does not. If it does, universal-scope transfer, applied to the distinct effect x, gives that c causes x's being in act in r; if it does not, nonuniversal transfer gives the same. So the cause of a thing's being causes each of its perfections. This is a grounded entry into the support cycle between this principle and the residual: no premise rests on either cycle member (universal-scope transfer is also projected from the unrestricted principle, but that projection is a transcription; its grounded derivation is from total causation, result UNIVERSAL-CAUSE-TRANSFERS-FROM-TOTAL-CAUSATION). The open content moves to nonuniversal transfer; universal-scope transfer and no self-causation of esse stay open, and excluded middle is the existing self-evident logical premise. The self-effect conjunct of the residual is not assumed but excluded. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established. Control.Controls parts 1 to 3 show that each nonlogical premise is needed in the interpretations given there.
